description: The Earth Polychromatic Imaging Camera (EPIC) is a ten-channel spectroradiometer imaging the sunlit Earth from ultraviolet through near-infrared wavelengths. Its narrow bands support ozone, aerosol, cloud and vegetation measurements.
facility_description: DSCOVR operates near the Sun–Earth L1 point, giving EPIC a view of the sunlit face of Earth.
notes: The NASA page displays mean filter transmission functions in Figure 9 and describes a backside-thinned CCD. DetectorType is unchanged. Exact provenance and licence of NJM numeric curves still require confirmation; a generic media policy alone is insufficient.
